entries.proposition: NOT WWOX EVIDENCE (Parkin). Endogenous Parkin is not detectable in the cells, and the whole map rests on overexpressed fusions; the authors name this as a limit.
entries.snippet: In the present study we therefore rely on overexpression of the Parkin variants.

entries.proposition: The therapeutic reading is proposed, not tested as a rescue: blocking degradation, stabilisers or pharmacological chaperones may raise abundance above a pathogenic threshold. The activator was the only candidate stabiliser tested, but bortezomib, siRNA against PSMD14 and low-temperature incubation were also used as degradation or stability probes and shifted the low-abundance population (Fig 3A-B, 3E).
entries.snippet: Hence, potentially blocking Parkin degradation or developing small molecule stabilizers or pharmacological chaperones, such as those for TP53 and CFTR84,85, may restore cellular abundance and increase function above the pathogenic threshold.
